goal_summary: Make the Last indexed value in a datasource's details move whenever a user starts a manual reindex, so users can tell the data was refreshed; the shipped design stamps the reindex trigger time, and we look for places where that stamp is missed, reverted or misleading (failed, queued, scheduled, provider, resume flows).

cross-team integration.reason: scheduled actors, concurrency manager, SharePoint processor and the health classifier share the same two timestamps; risks R-13, R-14, R-15 are registered

roles and permissions.reason: the diff changes no access rule; the stamp is written for the already-authorised reindex request

integrations with external systems.reason: provider reindex calls an external provider; status handling is R-11 and R-18; provider contract not read (OQ-8)

persistent and shared data.reason: last_reindex_triggered_at is a persisted column shared by manual, scheduled and queued writers; R-4, R-8, R-13, R-17

inputs and validation.reason: the change accepts no new input; only the displayed timestamp format is a risk (R-19, OQ-9)

failure and error paths.reason: failed, guardrail-blocked, queue-timeout and unknown provider status paths are registered as R-15, R-16, R-18

open_questions.question: Should Last indexed move for a failed, guardrail-blocked or queue-timed-out manual reindex? The stamp is written before processing.

source_says.quote: A successfully completed full reindex updates the repository's Last indexed timestamp.
Whether failed or guardrail-blocked runs should move 'Last indexed'
last_reindex_triggered_at > update_date -> STALE

readings.reading: Only a successful run moves Last indexed; a failed run keeps the old value.
readings.if_chosen: R-16 and R-15 are asserted as defects (failed or queue-timed-out run shows a fresh Last indexed); a bug draft is written for each observed case.

readings.reading: Last indexed is the trigger time regardless of outcome.
readings.if_chosen: R-16 and R-15 are recorded as documented behaviour; the health classifier STALE/FAILED result is the user-visible signal.

Entry points: BaseDatasourceProcessor.schedule() when a func ... is passed
